The build is green. 

## Summary

I implemented the welcome-notification requirement on successful owner creation (`POST /api/owners`).

**New function** — `EnqueueWelcomeNotification.java`:
- Reads the persisted `Owner` via `@Val`, and emits a single line on the logger named `NOTIFY` containing both the owner id and the `memberId`:
  ```
  NOTIFY.info("welcome owner id={} memberId={}", owner.getId(), owner.getMemberId());
  ```

**Pipeline wiring** — `owners.POST.yml`:
- Inserted an `enqueueWelcome` step between `audit` and `respond`, so it runs after `SaveOwner` (owner has its generated id) and `AssignOwnerMemberId` (memberId assigned), on the successful-create path only.

This follows the existing `AuditOwnerCreated` pattern (dedicated named SLF4J logger) and satisfies the new `AcceptanceTest.coreEnqueuesWelcome`, which captures the `NOTIFY` logger and asserts one line contains both the owner id and the fetched `memberId`.

**Tests:** `./mvnw test` → `BUILD SUCCESS`, all tests pass (the observed log confirms `NOTIFY - welcome owner id=11 memberId=NSW2716E6609E1`).
